text:
Sam (Partnerships): folks - we need an on-call cadence for marketplace compliance evidence & quick triage during the incoming pen-test window. who can own week-of rotations? :calendar:

Jena (Security): I can take the first week (Mon 5/2 - Sun 5/8). will handle pen-test triage + vuln ticket kickoffs.

Liam (Marketplace): can take wk2 (5/9-5/15). i'll also be primary for marketplace listing checks and publishing the evidence bundle.

Marco (SI): we'll need a parallel SI contact for partner-side uploads. i'll ask Priya on the SI team to be the backup for wk1/wk2.

Elaine (Legal): quick heads-up — any SOC/attestation docs that contain customer data must go through redaction before upload. pls follow redaction checklist we shared last quarter.

Sam (Partnerships): awesome. i want a short runbook for on-call: 1) receive artifact (presigned link) 2) validate manifest 3) redaction check 4) ingest to secure bucket 5) ack partner. can someone draft a 1-pager?

Jena (Security): i'll drop a minimal playbook in this thread later today. for now - we should require these artifacts: SOC2 type II PDF, pen-test report (full), remediation plan, verification screenshots (logs, scans), and contact for re-testing.

triage-bot: Reminder: upload window opens 2025-05-05T00:00Z and closes 2025-05-20T23:59Z. Please use the presign URL flow.

Liam (Marketplace): packaging notes: prefer this structure in the zip: 
```
manifest.yaml
soc2/soc2-type2.pdf
pentest/report.pdf
pentest/remediation.xlsx
screenshots/*.png
attestations/*.txt
```
Make manifest include sha256 hashes + owner email.

Sam (Partnerships): Marco — can SI partners push artifacts directly to our ingestion S3? what's the quick curl example we can share?

Marco (SI): yes, presigned links only. share this snippet with partners:
```
# upload file using presigned URL
curl -X PUT "${PRESIGN_URL}" -T report.zip -H "Content-Type: application/zip"
```
We also ask partners to append filename and manifest to the ticket.

Jena (Security): Security requirements quick checklist (short):
- Files encrypted at rest (we enforce S3 AES-256)
- No plaintext customer PII in artifacts (redact or mask)
- Pen-test run dates + scope included
- CVE mapping + mitigation status in remediation.xlsx

Elaine (Legal): add: a short attestation text signed by partner (name, title, date). we can accept PGP-signed or emailed acceptance.

Sam (Partnerships): about joint announcement — marketing wants a clear embargo date. do we want to gate announcement on final SOC upload or on remediation sign-off?

Liam (Marketplace): let's gate the public listing on SOC upload + remediation plan accepted by Security. announcement can be internal-only before that.

Jena (Security): agreed. we need a short QA pass after remediation: security-run verification scan + one small re-test from third-party pen team (if major findings).

Sam (Partnerships): ok timeline proposal:
```
05/05 - upload window opens
05/12 - last day to accept new evidence for initial review
05/20 - remediation accepted / final verification
05/25 - internal announcement
06/01 - public marketplace listing (if green)
```
Can everyone confirm?

Marco (SI): confirmed from SI side. we'll push partners to the 5/12 cutoff.

Jena (Security): confirmed. i'll schedule the verification scan for 05/21 and a re-test slot 05/22-05/24 if needed.

Elaine (Legal): confirmed on attestation format; i'll post a template after this.

triage-bot: New action created: #COMPLY-1345 — "Marketplace evidence rota + runbook" assigned to Sam. Due 2025-04-30.

Sam (Partnerships): will do runbook + short slack DM templates for partners. quick ask: who should be on the 24/7 emergency on-call if a high-severity vuln pops during the week?

Jena (Security): rotate sec-oncall escalation: Jena -> Rahul -> SecOps lead. i'll share the escalation matrix in the playbook.

Liam (Marketplace): added a small on-call table for the next month (wk starting):
```
05/05 Sam (Partnerships)
05/12 Liam (Marketplace)
05/19 Marco (SI) - partner followups
05/26 Sam (Partnerships) - final publish prep
```
We can swap if conflicts.

Sam (Partnerships): perfect. please flag any hard blockers now. if none, i'll push the runbook + presign instructions by EOD and tag everyone. :thumbsup:

Marco (SI): one blocker: some partners need more time to provide full pentest writeups — we'll escalate for exceptions but try to keep the window.

Jena (Security): note: if partner can't provide full report, we can accept interim attestation + scope doc but will delay public listing.

Elaine (Legal): i've uploaded the attestation template to the legal drive: https://drive.redwood.example/attestations/template-v1.docx

Sam (Partnerships): thanks. closing the thread for now — watch for the runbook post. we'll re-open if anything urgent pops. :wave:
